description: B1 AT A 36 IN DECKING TOP WITH ITS STAIR (STAIRS; buildings.md B1 'Stair': 'At a 36 in decking top: 5 risers of 7.2, 4 treads (44 in)'): b1-stair-30's tree with the deck's Height 30 -> 36 in, the stair re-laid by the same stored inputs: 5 risers of 7.2, 4 treads, the posts 6 in longer. model.json and members.json are pinned by packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_stair.py; services/geometry/tests/test_stair_b1.py checks them.
derivation: INDEPENDENT of the plugins: the deck is B1 with every member above the posts 6 in higher and each 6x6 post Z 0..16.5 (71 735.979474 + 3 x 5.5^2 x 6 = 72 280.479474 in^3), the stair typed as b1-stair-30's. The STEP matches the 63 solids solid for solid.
surface_area, centroid, mass_g and center_of_mass are the script's solids summed (test_stair_b1.expected_numbers()): southern_pine_pt 582 and concrete 2400 kg/m^3 (loft_wire.materials).

topology from the script's B-rep (faces, edges and one shell a solid); the kernel's build of model.json meets every count exactly. MESH counts are recorded, not derived (the piers' cylinders tessellate by the linear deflection).

Interference none (test_stair_b1.test_nothing_interferes probes every pair whose boxes overlap, exactly): each stringer stands plumb on the rim's face at Y 144 and level under the last board at Z 29 (test_the_stair_meets_the_deck_face_to_face), each tread on its stringer seats, each riser board on its riser cuts, the handrail on its posts' inside faces at X 78.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill): b1-stair-30's class over 63 bodies. The kernel differs from the script by -1.43e-6 mm^3 on the volume, 3.0e-8 mm^2 on the area, <= 2.3e-12 mm on the centroid and centre of mass and 4.7e-10 g on the mass. 1e-5 is 7x the volume's.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: KERNEL-LEVEL, b1-stair-30's class, measured 2026-10-29: volume +2.74e-5 mm^3, area -2.4e-7 mm^2, centroid 3.6e-11 mm (plugin); the build123d twin drifts +6.53e-5 / +3.0e-6 through build123d's export_step, so it is OCCT's STEP. 1e-4 is 1.5x the twin's and 3.6x the plugin's; volume and area only.
